column1: # 24 mod-calling settings, each run identically at three alignment filters
# (MAPQ >= 20, >= 10, and 0 = every mapped primary read) and with both backends:
# 144 parameter sets. The settings are one factor at a time around the current
# defaults (the *_baseline rows), mostly at a 2% false-positive rate so that sets
# are compared at the same background, plus two combinations.
# Set names are <backend>_q<mapq>_<setting>, so the same <setting> can be lined up
# across filters and backends. Tab-separated. Edit, add or delete rows freely;
# 'set' must be unique. Columns are documented at the top of mod_sweep.smk.
